{{Top}}
The '''B'omarr pipe organ''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] organ developed by the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Monks]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. A pipe organ was concealed behind a false wall in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].
